source_title: Arsenal transfer rumours: Tresoldi, Ramon, Batrakov - BBC
source_excerpt:
Arsenal, Tottenham , Manchester United and Chelsea are keeping a close eye on Nicolo Tresoldi, but Club Brugge have no intention of selling the 22-year-old German striker in January. (Football Insider) , external
The Gunners are monitoring 21-year-old Como defender Jacobo Ramon, with Chelsea and Manchester United also being linked with the Spaniard. (Mail - subscription required) , external
Arsenal and Liverpool may be edged out by Paris St-Germain or Barcelona in the pursuit of Galatasaray's 21-year-old Russia midfielder Aleksey Batrakov, who is open to a move to one of Europe's elite clubs. (Teamtalk) , external
